label: Lawn Care & Landscaping
description: Audit framework for lawn care, landscaping, and outdoor maintenance businesses.
voicePromptHints: Ask how long it takes to send a quote after an estimate visit.
Ask what percentage of one-time customers convert to recurring service.
Ask how they handle seasonal upsells like aeration or fertilization.
Ask how they follow up on quotes that go unanswered.
Ask if they have a formal referral or review-request program.
